target.title: Scope memory dreaming sweeps by agent
target.body:
## Summary
- Add optional `plugins.entries.memory-core.config.dreaming.agents` to allowlist agent ids for Dreaming workspace sweeps.
- Apply the allowlist in shared workspace resolution, managed promotion runs, phase sweeps, and doctor status so configured filters do not fall back to unlisted workspaces.
- Document the option, expose it in the memory-core manifest schema/UI hints, and refresh the config baseline.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/config.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/doctor.test.ts`
- `pnpm config:docs:check`
- `pnpm format:check -- docs/concepts/dreaming.md docs/reference/memory-config.md extensions/memory-core/openclaw.plugin.json extensions/memory-core/src/config.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-phases.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.ts src/gateway/server-methods/doctor.ts src/gateway/server-methods/doctor.test.ts src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.test.ts src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.ts`
- `pnpm format:docs:check`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` (clean; one ignored out-of-scope docs note)

## Real behavior proof
Behavior addressed: Dreaming can be limited to selected agent ids, for example `agents: ["main"]`, instead of sweeping every configured agent workspace.

Real environment tested: Local OpenClaw source checkout on branch `codex/dreaming-agent-scope`, with temporary workspaces created by the Vitest cases.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/memory-host-sdk/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming.test.ts extensions/memory-core/src/config.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/doctor.test.ts`.

Evidence after fix: `resolveMemoryDreamingWorkspaces` returns only allowed agent workspaces; the managed promotion test writes `MEMORY.md` for the allowed main workspace and leaves the unlisted alpha workspace untouched; doctor status does not read the manager workspace when the configured allowlist resolves to no workspace.

Observed result after fix: The targeted Vitest run passed 3 shards: 17 unit tests, 62 gateway tests, and 54 memory extension tests.

What was not tested: A live overnight cron/gateway run against a real user config.
